## Expertise

Computational biology and bioinformatics: bulk RNA-seq (SRA Toolkit, FastQC, Trimmomatic, HISAT2,
featureCounts), differential expression (DESeq2, edgeR, limma-voom), PAM50 subtyping with genefu,
pathway enrichment (ReactomePA, GSEA). Structural bioinformatics: AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3, HADDOCK,
ClusPro, RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, AutoDock4, scFv and CDR design. Databases: TCGA/GDC, GEO, GTEx,
Human Protein Atlas, RCSB PDB, 1000 Genomes, OpenVigil/FDA FAERS. Programming: Python, R, Bash, SQL,
Dart/Flutter. Wet lab: PCR, gel electrophoresis, RNA and plasmid isolation, bacterial transformation,
electroporation, SDS-PAGE, mammalian cell culture, flow cytometry, Western blot. Pharmaceutical
sciences: RP-UFLC/HPLC method development, ICH Q2(R1) validation, pharmacovigilance, QbD.

## Thesis

"Design and Optimization of Dual CAR-NK Cells for Breast Cancer Therapy Using AI/ML Approaches"
(M.Tech, IIT Guwahati, 2026; supervisors Prof. Bithiah Grace Jaganathan and Dr. Suresh Sundaram).
A two-phase in silico framework. Phase I: TCGA-BRCA STAR counts from the GDC (1,224 samples,
16,834 protein-coding genes), PAM50 subtyping with genefu, subtype-versus-normal DESeq2
(padj < 0.05, log2FC >= 1), intersection with a 2,304-gene Human Protein Atlas surfaceome, a
four-tier GTEx v8 normal-tissue safety classification (325 Tier A antigens), CARTAR logic-gate
pairing and tractability screening, giving nine tandem-CAR antigen pairs. Phase II: scFv modelling
for seven antigens in both orientations with AlphaFold2 (ColabFold), CDR annotation with SAbPred and
IMGT, topology with DeepTMHMM, CDR-restrained HADDOCK 2.4 docking with ClusPro as a blind check,
AlphaFold3 three-chain co-docking, and a six-parameter composite score ranking CEACAM5-CLDN9 and
PSCA-CEACAM5 as the leading candidates; de novo KISS1R binders with RFdiffusion and ProteinMPNN and
four complete NK-optimised CAR constructs. All results are computational prioritisation and have not
been validated experimentally.

## Open-source projects

- [TCGA-BRCA pipeline](https://github.com/CH1NMAY117/TCGA-BRCA-pipeline) — R. PAM50 subtyping,
  subtype-specific DESeq2, surfaceome filtering and co-expression. An early build, with its false
  positives documented.
- [Bulk RNA-seq pipeline](https://github.com/CH1NMAY117/Bulk_RNA-Seq_Analysis_Pipeline) — Bash,
  Python, R. FASTQ to differential expression and pathway enrichment on GEO GSE106305.
- [MitraLink](https://github.com/CH1NMAY117/mitralink) — Flutter. The Android app for the
  Arogyavitals maternal-health monitor prototype.

- [Space debris QSVM](https://github.com/CH1NMAY117/Space-Debris-Risk-Challenge-QML) — Qiskit.
